en: Dependent on a non-root state that is neither with vitakka nor with vicāra, there arises a root state with vitakka and vicāra by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root state that is neither with vitakka nor with vicāra-mattā, there arises a root state with vicāra-mattā by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-causal state that is without applied thought and sustained thought, there arises a non-causal state without applied thought and sustained thought by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three under root, three under predominance … pe … three under non-disappearance.
